_comment: Spec 115 — the campaign layer's single source. A CAMPAIGN is what we are raising for and who it reaches; it gets a page. A DRIVE is a dated way we raise it; it feeds exactly one campaign and is a row on that campaign's page until it earns its own page (as popcorn did). Adding a drive is appending one object here. Set published:false to keep a verified record on file without publishing it. Dates are ISO (YYYY-MM-DD) and read as LOCAL dates. raised stays null until a number is real.

campaigns.name: Send 6 to the US Open
campaigns.blurb: Six adaptive athletes at the US Open in Naples, with nothing out of pocket. About $3,500 covers one athlete's equipment, training, and travel.

drives.name: August popcorn drive
drives.supports: Every bag moves us toward Send 6 to the US Open: six adaptive athletes on the court in Naples, spring 2027, with nothing out of pocket.
drives.summary: Small batch popcorn, shipped to your door. Half of every order comes back to the fund.

drives._note: Verified 2026-07-24 and held back pending Spec 115 decision D1: whether ATL has athletes entered in the Aug 9 Wheelchair Open Doubles bracket.
